# Which drinks on your menu actually make money?

> Free calculator for coffee shop owners: what each latte, cold brew and drip coffee really earns after beans, milk, cup, card fee and barista time. Margin per drink, profit per barista-hour, target price, break-even drinks per day. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
